summary: This unit works out the fixed charge on one customer's bill from the tariff code, the load in kW, and the energy used.

rules.text: If the tariff is A2, then the fixed charge is 400 multiplied by the load in kW.
If the tariff is A1 and the energy used is below 75, then the fixed charge is 75 minus the energy used.
If the tariff is A1 and the energy used is 75 or more, then the fixed charge is 0.
If the tariff is neither A1 nor A2, then the fixed charge is 0.
The fixed charge starts at 0 before the tariff is checked.
If the debug switch is set to 1, then the calculated fixed charge is written to the debug output before it is returned. The bill amount is not changed by this.
